ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a pond food web, with “Pondweed” labeled at the bottom left and “Microscopic algae” labeled at the bottom right. The organism labels include “Mayfly nymph” on the left, “Freshwater shrimp” on the right, “Dragonfly nymph” in the middle, and “Brown trout” at the top. The green arrows indicate food to the animal that eats it. Reasoning: Looking at the arrows coming from “Pondweed” and “Microscopic algae”, apart from shrimp excluded in the question, Mayfly nymph also receives arrows from both pondweed and microscopic algae. Therefore, besides shrimp, the organism that eats both algae and pondweed is mayfly nymph.
